text:
maya: Heads-up — we're opening a short publish window tomorrow 09:00-09:30 PT for py/ts SDKs to push v2.4.0 and deprecate the legacy sync client. Please read rollout/rollback plan below. :calendar: 

sam: Ack. I'll be on the publish call. What are the exact pin/deprec steps?

maya: Plan outline: 
- Publish canary -> smoke -> GA in that order. 
- Py: twine upload to pypi-staging then pypi. TS: npm publish with tag canary then latest. 
- After GA, we will set a soft-deprec message on the old sync package and pin major-1 in our internal compatibility matrix. 

toni: Do we need a dev-bot trigger? I can run the publish bot if it's easier.

deploy-bot: maya requested a release window at 2024-07-09T16:00:00Z, slot reserved. Run `/release start --pkg @redwood/sdk-ts --ver 2.4.0 --tag canary` to begin.`

jeff: Add a quick smoke test step that hits the hosted API and validates embeddings/generation with the smoke prompt set. If that fails we rollback immediately.

maya: Agreed. Smoke tests: 
```
# python
pytest tests/smoke/test_integration.py::test_generation --maxfail=1
# js
node ./scripts/smoke-check.js
```
Fail -> DON'T publish latest, instead: 
- For Py: yank the version from PyPI and republish fixed patch 2.4.1. 
- For TS: unpublish canary tag and publish patched 2.4.1-canary then GA.

priya: How are we handling internal pinning for customers on major-1? I want to make sure we don't auto-upgrade anyone.

maya: We'll update the customer-facing docs and the console default route to point to 2.4.0 for new projects. Existing projects remain pinned to major-1 unless they opt-in. Ops will add an org-level flag `sdk_auto_upgrade=false` for the next 2 weeks.

sam: Release notes snippet for deprecation: 
"As part of the 2.4.0 release we are deprecating the legacy synchronous client. We recommend migrating to the new async-first clients. A compatibility shim will be available for 6 months."

toni: For npm, after GA I'll run: 
```
npm deprecate @redwood/sdk-sync "Deprecated: please migrate to @redwood/sdk" --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
```
And for PyPI: `python -m pip index versions redwood-sdk` -> then `twine upload`/yank commands as needed.

deploy-bot: smoke-tests passed for ts-canary at 1759994550. Logs: https://ci.internal/1759994550 :white_check_mark: 

jeff: Good sign. Once py canary smoke passes, let's coordinate the GA flip in a 5-min aligned window. I'll watch logs and be ready to revert traffic routing if token errors spike.

priya: Ops note: I'll set `sdk_auto_upgrade=false` and send an email to the escrow list with migration doc link once GA is published.

maya: Final rollback checklist (short): 
1) Stop GA publish. 
2) For Py: yank 2.4.0, republish 2.4.1 with fix. Update docs. 
3) For TS: deprecate/remove latest tag, republish patched canary and finish GA. 
4) Reopen incident channel & notify customers on committed seats.

sam: One more ask — let's tag the release in the repo and attach changelog. I'll run the tagging: `git tag -a v2.4.0 -m "2.4.0 release" && git push origin v2.4.0` after we confirm GA.

maya: Sounds good. I'll be on the call at 09:00 PT. Please be nearby for quick rollback. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: GA publish for ts and py scheduled at 1759994720. Watchlist configured: logs, error-rate, token-costs. If error-rate > 1% in 3 minutes -> automated rollback triggered.

jeff: Noted. Will coordinate rollback if threshold hits.

sam: Thanks team — I'll post final release note blurb in #product after GA. :shipit: 

maya: Thanks — closing thread until tomorrow's window.
